name: Mureka
good_for: Generating original songs, background music, soundscapes and AI music videos from text prompts
watch_out: Free plan: 4 songs a day on the free model; Pro: up to 500 songs a month with MP3 downloads only (WAV and stems need Premier, $30/month)

name: Loudly
good_for: AI text-to-music with commercial licensing and distribution to Spotify, Apple Music and YouTube Music
watch_out: Personal: 2,500 credits/month; free plan is non-commercial with 1 download per day

name: Boomy
price_from: $14.99/month (Creator list price; the page currently shows a 33% discount)
good_for: Making and releasing original AI songs with full commercial rights, even with no music experience
watch_out: Free plan: 25 song saves, no downloads, no commercial use; Creator includes 25 WAV downloads per month

name: Stable Audio
good_for: Generating royalty-free tracks with the Stable Audio web app and DAW plugin
watch_out: Solo: 660 credits/month; credits reset monthly and do not roll over

name: iAsk
good_for: AI search with an AI writer, instant summarizer and document analysis
watch_out: Pro: 300 daily Pro searches; free tier has limited ads and uses the non-Pro model

name: Recraft
good_for: Generating and editing images with multiple AI models (Flux, GPT Image, Nano Banana); video generation on Pro
watch_out: Basic: 1,000 credits/month; free-plan images are public with no commercial use

name: v0
good_for: Generating complete web apps and UIs from text prompts, deployed to Vercel
watch_out: Plus is priced per user; free plan limited to 7 messages per day

name: Warp
good_for: AI-assisted coding in a modern terminal with Warp Agent
watch_out: Build: 1,500 credits ($20 of agent usage at API rates); extra usage is pay-as-you-go

name: Zed
good_for: A fast code editor with AI edit predictions and token-based AI features
watch_out: Pro includes $5 of tokens; usage beyond that bills at API list price +10%
